findings.finding: Q3 is likely to carry another US Commercial Property Development impairment. Skanska blamed Q2's SEK -464M charge on completed unsold US properties on 'the rise in long-term US interest rates' when the 10-year moved only +14bp (4.30% to 4.44%); in Q3 it rose +85bp to 5.29% on 30 Sep, the appraisal date. Completed projects carried just SEK 822M of unrealized gain on SEK 18.5bn of book value at 30 Jun.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 had a -0.7bn US CD impairment and PBT missed consensus by 21% (1,527 vs 1,927); the stock fell 4.7%. Q2 2026's -0.46bn impairment was offset by the I-4 gain and a construction beat, and the stock rose 1.1%.
findings.original_quote: Operating income was SEK -170 M (86), adversely impacted by asset impairment charges of SEK -464 M, incurred on a few completed unsold properties in the US, reflecting a negative development in market values following macroeconomic uncertainty and the rise in long-term US interest rates. (Yields: US Treasury par curve, 10 Yr 4.44 on 06/30/2026 and 5.29 on 09/30/2026, https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/daily-treasury-rates.csv/2026/all?type=daily_treasury_yield_curve&field_tdr_date_value=2026&page&_format=csv)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Jefferies flagged the rate risk on 5 Oct and the stock fell that day. Since then the stock has risen about 10% over 20 sessions as the 10-year eased back to 4.95%, which is pricing the CURRENT rate. The Q3 appraisal is struck at the 30 Sep peak of 5.29%, and the prior-quarter consensus did not carry impairments. If this were fully priced, the run-up would not have taken the stock to a 2026 high into the print.
findings.independence: Jefferies' downgrade cites the same mechanism and the SEK 24bn US CD exposure: https://efn.se/jefferies-oroas-av-rantan-slopar-koprad-pa-byggjatten (2026-10-05). Same mechanism, different source.

findings.finding: Nordic peers reported strong Q3s in the last two weeks. NCC's operating profit before items affecting comparability was SEK 831M against a 700M Modular consensus, with improved contracting margins and higher orders. All four Peab business areas improved operating margin (Q3 EBIT 1,296 vs 1,148). JM sold 2,166 homes against 1,550. This is a positive read-through for Skanska's Nordic construction and Residential Development Nordics, the weak spot in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On Q2 the Nordic residential weakness ('bostäder tynger') was the headline negative, alongside a +1.1% day. Peer report days this round: NCC +3.3% (3 Nov), Peab -0.7% (28 Oct), JM +10.1% (21 Oct); Skanska +0.25% and +1.5% on 3 and 4 Nov.
findings.original_quote: Väntat rörelseresultat, enligt konsensus från Modular Finance med tre analytikers estimat, ligger på 700 miljoner kronor. (NCC consensus, Placera 2026-10-29; translation: expected operating profit, per Modular Finance consensus of three analysts, is SEK 700 million.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The peer prints are public and Skanska rose 1.5% on 4 Nov. What may be left is how far analysts lift Skanska's Nordic numbers after NCC, which reported only 2 days before; the Nordics are roughly a third of Skanska's Construction, net of a US business that dominates EBIT.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 record order intake ('orderingången högre än väntat'): +1.1% on the day. In the Q3 2025 report, orders above expectation did not offset the impairment miss (-4.7%).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. Every large contract is a public release and analysts sum them, so only the unannounced smaller-order remainder is new. Sized toward 0 under the already-public rule.

baseline_tension: The impairment finding cuts against the +10.3% 20-day run-up, which looks like the market pricing October's yield relief rather than the 30 Sep appraisal; the peer and order findings agree with the run-up. On net the findings roughly offset, so the lean is mildly negative against a mildly negative priced_lean (-0.52).
language_note: Swedish sources (Placera/Finwire) carried this name's observed report-day reactions (Q1-26 -2.2, Q4-25 -2.6, Q3-25 -4.7, Q2-25 +0.4 ...) and the prior-quarter Bloomberg consensus format; the English sources did not.

Swedish sources carried the Q3 2025 consensus miss (PBT 1,527 vs 1,927) that shows the consensus excludes impairments (Aktiespararna, 'Skanska bommar förväntningarna'), and NCC's Q3 Modular consensus of 700 used to measure the peer beat.
EFN (Swedish) carried Jefferies' 5 Oct downgrade on rate risk to US CD ('Jefferies oroas av räntan – slopar köpråd på byggjätten'); I found no English wire copy of it.
Skanska's own filings were bilingual and identical; the Swedish versions added nothing to them.
lessons_applied: Already-public rule: the order-flow finding cut from +0.4 to +0.2 and the CD divestment finding from +0.2 to +0.1, because both rest on releases the market has had for weeks.
One-off rule ('a beat made of a one-off is sold', one-offs sized at a fraction): the US impairment relabelled one_off and cut from -1.0 to -0.8.
Proxy rule (a narrow proxy is a hypothesis): the Nordic peer read-through cut from +0.5 to +0.4.

Understatement rule (size the move on what is new, not the name's small history): abs_move_pct raised from 3.5 to 4.0, since the quarter's numbers are new although no guidance is given; p_up unchanged at 45.
